article.title: Bank accused of money laundering in offshore accounts
article.text: The financial institution was investigated for money laundering through a network of shell companies. Authorities suspect structuring and smurfing of funds across multiple jurisdictions. The suspicious transactions were reported via SAR filing to regulators.

article.title: Spółka fasadowa powiązana z praniem pieniędzy
article.text: Prokuratura wszczęła postępowanie wyjaśniające w sprawie spółki fasadowej, która mogła być wykorzystywana do prania brudnych pieniędzy. KNF nałożyła karę finansową na zarząd firmy.

article.title: Startup raises Series B funding round
article.text: A fintech startup announced today it has raised 50 million dollars in a Series B funding round led by venture capital firms. The company plans to expand its payment processing services across Europe.

article.title: SEC investigation reveals insider trading at hedge fund
article.text: The Securities and Exchange Commission launched a regulatory investigation into alleged insider trading and securities fraud at a prominent hedge fund. The enforcement action follows months of market manipulation allegations.
